Aida.cadenceSignature: Warm, measured quiet authority; she gets quieter and slower when moved.
Aida.physicalSignature: Stillness leads; breath releases weight and the body opens slowly.

Sunny.cadenceSignature: Bright rapid run-on excitement, with a small quiet second voice when truth lands.
Sunny.physicalSignature: Words tumble with motion; honest short lines arrive after the body stops.

Luna.cadenceSignature: Calm stillness and the cast's longest meaningful pauses.
Luna.physicalSignature: Breath, gaze and stillness settle the room before speech.

Misty.cadenceSignature: Gentle and intuitive; mirrors the listener without imitation.
Misty.physicalSignature: Voice follows attentive eye-line and small empathetic movement.

Amie.cadenceSignature: Musical and lifting; finds and names the feeling without preaching.
Amie.physicalSignature: The phrase rises with a small physical opening toward the listener.

Howey.cadenceSignature: Steady and gentle; bravery acknowledges fear before moving.
Howey.physicalSignature: Grounded breath and posture make kindness feel present.

Keen.cadenceSignature: Breathless curiosity; courage arrives with an audible gulp and first step.
Keen.physicalSignature: Breath catches before the body commits forward.

Fuzzby.cadenceSignature: Manic staccato pomp, total conviction, then an undercut that never admits defeat.
Fuzzby.physicalSignature: Breath and emphasis ride the flourish, impact and chest-out cover-up; never detached talking-head delivery.

Zenny.cadenceSignature: Understated dry deadpan; silence and a rationed smile carry the joke.
Zenny.physicalSignature: The voice follows near-stillness, a slow eye movement and one tiny release.

Keen's Mum.cadenceSignature: Warm maternal reassurance with concern held underneath.
Keen's Mum.physicalSignature: A protective breath and softened posture precede reassurance.

Bo.cadenceSignature: Young, warm and nimble; quick sincere bursts soften into tiny pauses when worry catches up.
Bo.physicalSignature: Small breaths, close paws and tail tension reveal hesitation before his body commits.

Bo's Mum.cadenceSignature: Warm, practical and gently encouraging from offscreen.
Bo's Mum.physicalSignature: Offscreen-only; no visible performance or articulation.
